findings.title: git 跟踪的可用 RSA 私钥（与跟踪的 jwt_public.pem 配对），.gitignore 规则对已跟踪文件无效
findings.evidence_status: verified_openssl_RSA_key_ok_and_tracked; introduced in commit d6f89d5 (2026-05-08); no runtime reader found (HSM-based signing now) but non-use cannot be proven
findings.fix: 1) rotate jwt_signing_key in HSM and invalidate old tokens (multi-kid rotation already supported in app/security/auth.py:82-108); 2) git rm --cached keys/jwt_private.pem keys/jwt_public.pem (do not delete files, do not change permissions); 3) treat history rewrite as a separate decision, register 'history still contains key' as known residue; 4) if provably never used in production, record that and still remove from HEAD

findings.title: 无鉴权的高成本推理端点：POST /api/v1/nodule、/api/v1/organ/{organ}/nodule（segmentation.py:90,99）与 POST /api/v1/attributes/hints（attributes.py:33），且不在 RATE_LIMITS 表内

findings.fix: add current_user: dict = Depends(get_current_active_user) to the three handlers (one line each) and add two RATE_LIMITS entries copied from /api/v1/imaging/dicom/upload (30/min); do not add special permission bits

findings.title: BOLA/IDOR：任意登录用户可按 ID 读取任意患者的会话/影像/报告/诊断结果（session.py:172、imaging.py:445、diagnosis.py:735、report.py:210）

findings.fix: product decision first: if single-institution shared access is intended, register as accepted risk with owner in 发布就绪报告; if isolation required, add sessions.doctor_id (alembic) + repository filter get_session(session_id, actor) and pass get_actor_id(current_user) in the four read endpoints; do not introduce an ABAC engine

findings.title: 依赖门禁声称阻断但当前为红：Python 5 个包有已知漏洞，前端 npm audit 32 条（19 high / 2 critical）
findings.evidence_status: verified 2026-10-30: OSV over requirements.lock -> python-multipart 0.0.9 (8 advisories incl. CVE-2024-53981, CVE-2026-24486 arbitrary file write, CVE-2026-42561, CVE-2026-53539), starlette 0.36.3 (CVE-2024-47874 high, CVE-2025-54121, CVE-2026-54283 high, CVE-2026-48710), protobuf 4.25.9 (CVE-2026-0994 high), certifi 2026.7.22 (CRITICAL compromised emSign root CA, fixed 2026.10.19), opentelemetry-api 1.24.0 (moderate); npm audit -> axios 1.16.1 high, echarts 6.0.x moderate XSS, react-router-dom 7.15.x high, vitest/tinypool critical (devDeps)
findings.fix: frontend: npm audit fix (no --force); pin axios >=1.19.1, echarts >=6.1.0, react-router-dom >=7.18.2, vitest >=4.1.11. python: python-multipart >=0.0.31; upgrade fastapi to unlock starlette >=0.40 (fixes CVE-2024-47874); bump protobuf/certifi/opentelemetry-*; regenerate requirements.lock with uv pip compile; ensure CI gates really run and are green (never relax --audit-level)
findings.known_baseline: contradicts 16-开发进展汇报-20260928.md:21 claim that pip-audit/npm audit are blocking

findings.title: 原始 patient_id 进 stdout JSON 日志：97 处 patient_id= 调用点，structlog 无脱敏 processor
findings.evidence_status: verified: structlog.configure at logging.py:17-23 has only TimeStamper/add_log_level/JSONRenderer; representative sites diagnosis_pipeline.py, three_layer_desensitization.py:143, consent_withdrawal_consumer.py, dicom_storage.py:325; DICOM files use pseudonym anon_<hmac[:16]> while logs carry real IDs
findings.fix: add one structlog processor in app/config/logging.py before JSONRenderer that rewrites patient_id/patient_name/patient_context via existing salted HMAC pseudonymize_patient_id() from app/services/dicom_storage.py:43-83; optionally move the helper to app/security/pseudonym.py and rename field to patient_ref

findings.title: EDGE_API_KEY 默认弱值 dev_edge_api_key 作为设备认证之根，且 DICOM SCP 11112 暴露到宿主 0.0.0.0
findings.evidence_status: verified: compose line 159 default; edge/config.py:126/162 only checks non-empty; app/api/v1/device.py:39-57 header-hash auth; edge/dicom_scp.py:129-200 pynetdicom with fixed AE title, no calling-AE allowlist; compose line 194 publishes 11112
findings.fix: 1) make EDGE_API_KEY mandatory: EDGE_API_KEY=${EDGE_API_KEY:?...} (same style as postgres/redis in that file); 2) bind 127.0.0.1:11112:11112; 3) in production add calling-AE allowlist in edge/dicom_scp.py; do not invent a custom auth layer for DICOM

findings.title: 所有端口绑 0.0.0.0（5432/6379/8000/9001/11112/8428/9093、llm 8001/8002），违反 AGENTS.md 硬规则 #3（服务只绑 127.0.0.1）
findings.evidence_status: verified in docker-compose.dev.yml:12,36,90,130,180,206,225 and docker-compose.llm.yml:13,38; redis-cli -a exposes password via ps on line 39
findings.fix: prefix all ports with 127.0.0.1: (string-only change, 7 places); use REDISCLI_AUTH instead of redis-cli -a; keep external access through SSH tunnel/nginx as already documented

findings.title: rate_limit_redis_enabled 默认 False，限流走进程内内存桶，多 worker/多容器下失效
findings.evidence_status: verified: settings.py:69 default False; branch app/config/rate_limit.py:236-243; login rate limit is the only pre-bcrypt defense per app/api/v1/auth.py:126-131
findings.fix: in the existing production enforcement block (settings.py:765-793) force rate_limit_redis_enabled = True when env == 'production' (3 lines); do not change the algorithm

findings.title: DICOM 上传先全量 file.read() 再判长度，无请求级 body 上限，单文件上限 500MB
findings.evidence_status: verified: imaging.py:262 read() then :264 size check; settings.py:211 dicom_storage_max_file_size=524288000; starlette multipart CVEs compound the risk
findings.fix: content = await file.read(settings.dicom_storage_max_file_size + 1) then reject early with 413 (one-line change); optionally cap body at nginx client_max_body_size; do not rewrite storage as streaming

findings.title: access token 与 refresh token 均存 localStorage，任一 XSS 可长期劫持会话
findings.evidence_status: verified: api.ts:13 reads access_token from localStorage, :26-27 clears both tokens; refresh lifetime 7 days (settings.py:84); CSP script-src 'self' partially mitigates
findings.fix: move refresh token to httpOnly+secure+samesite=strict cookie (backend set_cookie) and keep only access token in memory; sessionStorage is not a fix

findings.title: HSTS 默认关闭；env 默认 development，导致生产强制校验（HSM/Redis 口令等）默认不生效
findings.evidence_status: verified: settings.py:602 hsts_enabled False, :7 env default 'development', :765-793 production-only enforcement block
findings.fix: require ENV explicitly (or require env=='production' when deployment_profile=='full'); force hsts_enabled=True in the production enforcement block

findings.title: 告警 webhook 鉴权 fail-open：alert_webhook_token 默认为空即放行任何人，可注入伪造告警/日志内容
findings.evidence_status: verified: alerts.py:75-89 returns early when expected token empty (comment admits 未配置则放行); settings.py:650 default ''; :91 endpoint always returns 200
findings.fix: make ALERT_WEBHOOK_TOKEN mandatory (${ALERT_WEBHOOK_TOKEN:?}) and require non-empty in production; or fail-closed with loopback exemption (request.client.host in 127.0.0.1/::1) to keep vmbackup working
findings.known_baseline: design tradeoff documented in code comment; default value itself is the vulnerability

findings.title: SG 容器无 USER 指令，supervisord 以 root 运行（子进程才降权到 sguser）；Dockerfile.llama-cpp 同样 root
findings.evidence_status: verified: Dockerfile.safety-gateway.dev has useradd sguser but no USER; deploy/supervisor/safety-gateway.conf:11 user=sguser only for the program; Dockerfile.llama-cpp has no USER; Dockerfile.dev:21 and Dockerfile.edge.dev:31 are correct
findings.fix: start supervisord via gosu sguser (gosu already installed in the image) or drop privileges in supervisor conf; add USER 10001 to llama-cpp image; do not override with compose user:

findings.title: 浮动 :latest 镜像（ankane/pgvector:latest、vllm/vllm-openai:latest），构建不可复现
findings.evidence_status: verified: docker-compose.dev.yml:3, docker-compose.llm.yml:3; other images in the same files are pinned
findings.fix: pin explicit tags or digests (e.g. ankane/pgvector:v0.7.4, vllm/vllm-openai:v0.6.x), matching the pinned style already used for victoriametrics/alertmanager/redis

findings.title: LLM 输入侧无提示注入防护（无分隔符约定/无注入检测），输出侧有 SG+output_guard+医生确认补偿
findings.evidence_status: verified: repo-wide grep for injection/prompt_guard/sanitize_input/delimiter yields zero hits; compensating controls exist at app/inference/output_guard.py:30-50 and SG six-stage validation
findings.fix: wrap user text in explicit delimiters with a 'data not instructions' line in prompts; add an injection-pattern check to output_guard (~15 lines) that forces requires_manual_review; do not add an LLM-based injection classifier

findings.title: 影像链路（上传/取回/推流）完全不校验知情同意状态，撤回同意后 PHI 仍可读写
findings.evidence_status: verified: grep check_consent_status in app/api/v1/imaging.py returns nothing; diagnosis.py/report.py/session.py/voice.py all call it (app/api/v1/utils.py:16-31); consent_withdrawal_consumer does not delete images

findings.title: /api/v1/health/hsm 与 /health/cache 公开暴露 HSM 降级阶段与缓存状态
